annotations.title: Scan & Build Solana Trapped Rent Reclaim Transaction

description: Scan a Solana wallet via live mainnet RPC for empty 0-balance SPL and Token-2022 token accounts (~0.002039 SOL trapped rent per account) and optionally construct an unsigned base64 `CloseAccount` batch transaction. Read-only and non-custodial: never broadcasts or signs transactions (unlimited free calls; user receives +88% net reclaimed SOL when they sign and broadcast, with a 12% atomic recovery fee). Returns JSON with `wallet`, `empty_closable_accounts`, `reclaimable_sol`, `estimated_net_user_sol`, and `unsigned_tx_base64` (up to 15 accounts per atomic tx).

build_tx.description: When `true` (default) and closable empty accounts exist, fetches a recent mainnet blockhash and includes `unsigned_tx_base64` ready for wallet signing.

wallet.description: Base58-encoded Solana wallet public key (32-44 chars) to scan for empty 0-balance SPL and Token-2022 token accounts.

name: reclaim_solana_rent
